summary: Josh Lloyd and Nick from Locked On Mavericks preview the 2026/27 Dallas Mavericks. The team has a new front office under Masai Ujiri and a new head coach in Dusty May. Nick calls the season a rebuild on the fly and a fact-finding mission built around Cooper Flagg, and he predicts about 41 wins and a play-in spot. Big questions: Dereck Lively's foot injury (less than 10% chance he is ready opening night), whether Flagg's shooting improves, and Kyrie Irving staying as a veteran guard after missing a full season with an ACL injury. The roster is crowded with wings and short on real guards. Daniel Gafford is expected to be traded. For fantasy, the main interest is the center spot: draft Gafford if he starts, and Lively becomes draftable if he starts.
